payload.title: Prevent concurrent issue handoff Actions from conflicting on active/current.json
payload.body:
## Reproduction
Create two or more issues close together. Each `issue-agent-trigger.yml` run writes `.agents/handoffs/active/current.json` directly to `main`. Concurrent runs rebase and conflict on the same file.

## Evidence
- Run 29505640899 for issue #7 failed with `CONFLICT (add/add): .agents/handoffs/active/current.json`.
- Run 29505644971 for issue #8 failed with the same conflict.
- Only issue #6 succeeded.

## Pinpointed cause
The workflow has no repository-wide concurrency group for handoff state mutation and stores one global active file in Git. Concurrent issue events race while rebasing/pushing main.

## Required fix
- Serialize all handoff-state mutation runs with one concurrency group, or stop committing mutable active state directly to main.
- Preserve a separate immutable event file for every issue.
- Retry only safe non-conflicting pushes.
- Do not lose issue #7/#8 event records when multiple issues open together.

## Acceptance
Opening three issues concurrently creates three event records, updates active state deterministically, and all Action runs succeed.
